convergence.methodology: Each weakly connected causal component counts as at most one confirmation; unconnected factors are independent units. Mixed strength compares confidence-weighted evidence on both sides.

contradiction_resolution.methodology: Aligned requires one directional side only. Opposing evidence is MIXED; STRONGLY_MIXED requires the weaker independent side to be substantial relative to the stronger side. This result does not alter BUY/WAIT/SELL.
